nativeValidation.setup: Run in elevated Windows PowerShell 5.1 inside a clean disposable Windows guest on delino-win-1. Run the first command, copy the listed files into that directory, then run the last two commands. The script registers and removes the LocalSystem SCM service and uses a loopback-only test listener. Keep the transcript and isolated guest.log.
commands: Get-Content 'C:\OwnSandPathValidation\windows-artifacts.sha256' | ForEach-Object { $hash, $name = $_ -split '  ', 2; if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath (Join-Path 'C:\OwnSandPathValidation' $name)).Hash -ne $hash) { throw "SHA256 mismatch: $name" } }
expectedResults: The artifact hashes match and all three selected Windows regression tests pass. The hard-link alias and leading empty request PATH cases resolve to the expected absolute file.

The SCM service reports Running and LocalSystem. Bare cmd reports the System32 current directory with exit 0 when PATH is inherited, explicitly names System32, or starts with an empty entry followed by System32.
A relative-only match and a different cmd.exe earlier in the request PATH both report OTHER with no stdout or stderr.
An independent absolute fixture runs both by bare name with request PATH and by its direct absolute name. A missing program reports PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND.
The probe reports eight PASS lines and exits 0. The temporary service is stopped and removed.
